correctness.rationale: For fixed 2 or 3 vertices per side, independent edges of probability q when incident to either of two predetermined flexible vertices and p otherwise, enumerating every 2^(n²) graph with exact maximum-matching cardinality gives D2=(q-p)(1-q)(2q²-q+1), D3=(q-p)P(p,q) with printed polynomial. The source independently uses subset DP and permutation matching and verifies 512 n=3 graphs; a complete degree-8 simplex homogeneous expansion H=-L^8 P_q(u/L,(u+v)/L) has 43 strictly positive coefficients and two endpoint zeros, guaranteeing P_q<0 on 0<p<=q<=1. The exact boundary identities P(p,p)>0,P(p,1)=-p(1-p)²<0 give one interior q*(p). Independent brute-force graph evaluation and rational samples confirmed factorization and q=1 witness; finite enumeration here IS exhaustive for n<=3; no claim beyond n=3.
